map.三项判定：滴点 ≥180℃（高温不流失）、锥入度 220~295（0.1mm，稠: Three judgements: drop point ≥180°C (no flow at high temperature), cone penetration 220~295 (0.1mm, moderate consistency), corrosion test ≤ grade 1 (no corrosion of metal). All three must pass to be conforming; any failure means non-conforming.
map.按滴点、锥入度、腐蚀试验三项判定润滑脂是否合格: Judge lubricant grease conformance from drop point, cone penetration and corrosion test
map.输出各项结论与综合判定: Output each conclusion and the overall judgement

map.润滑脂进货验收：按滴点、锥入度、腐蚀试验三项指标判定是否合格: Lubricant grease incoming inspection: judge conformance from the three indicators of drop point, cone penetration and corrosion test
map.设备润滑选型：依据滴点与工况温度选合适润滑脂: Equipment lubricant selection: choose a suitable grease based on drop point and operating temperature
map.质量追溯：检测结果形成可归档的合格/不合格报告: Quality traceability: inspection results form an archivable pass/fail report

map.锥入度是稠度指标，数值越大越软；220~295 为常用 2 号脂区间: Cone penetration is a consistency index; the larger the value the softer the grease, and 220~295 is the common No. 2 grease range
map.过软易泄漏、过硬泵送困难，须与设备要求匹配: Too soft leaks easily, too hard is hard to pump, so it must match the equipment requirements
map.滴点低于 180℃ 在高温轴承上易软化流失，加剧磨损: A drop point below 180°C softens and lets lubricant run off in high-temperature bearings, worsening wear
map.腐蚀试验不合格会腐蚀金属件，严禁用于精密/重要部位: A failed corrosion test means corrosion of metal parts — strictly forbidden in precision or critical locations
map.锥入度大小代表什么？: What does cone penetration size mean?
map.锥入度是润滑脂稠度指标，数值越大越软；220~295 为常用 2 号脂区间，过软: Cone penetration is a grease consistency index; the larger the value the softer the grease. 220~295 is the common No. 2 grease range; too soft leaks easily, too hard is hard to pump, so it must match the equipment requirements.
map.滴点低于 180℃ 有什么风险？: What is the risk of a drop point below 180°C?
map.滴点是润滑脂开始流失的温度，低于 180℃ 在高温轴承/齿轮上易软化流失失去润滑: The drop point is the temperature at which grease starts to run off; below 180°C it softens and flows away in high-temperature bearings/gears, loses lubrication, worsens wear and can even cause overheating.
